selected_config.generation_instruction: A young adult woman with a distinctly LOW alto speaking voice, rich rounded chest resonance and warm, smooth lower notes. The comfortable speaking pitch is roughly 155 to 175 hertz. Slight natural huskiness, grounded confidence and a friendly easygoing gamer-coder manner. Keep full vocal body even on light syllables. Speak English with a General American accent as one fully grown adult woman in her twenties. Keep the actual acoustic speaking register LOW, with full chest resonance, comfortable breath support and clear normal speech. Talk casually to a familiar friend while working at a computer. Maintain the same mature low-register identity through the genuine question and small relieved smile at the end. Use natural connected speech and understated variation, never an announcer cadence. Her ordinary pitch remains low; emotional inflections are modest. No squeaky, girlish, thin, nasal or breathy whisper delivery. This is natural adult conversation, not theatrical character acting.
